title: Design config-file and campaign registry storage defaults
description: Follow-up to ADR 0003. The first CLI release intentionally keeps LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH required, but future work should design per-platform app-data roots, a config file, and a campaign registry/picker before introducing implicit campaign database locations.
close_reason: ADR 0004 (config file + campaign registry storage) authored, accepted, and merged in PR #36. Follow-up implementation tracked by loreweaver-d4r.3/.4/.5.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Design delivered as ADR 0004 (docs/adr/0004-config-file-and-campaign-registry.md): per-user data root with LOREWEAVER_HOME + per-platform defaults, non-secret config.json with documented precedence, JSON campaign registry + picker. LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH explicit-path mode is preserved (ADR 0003 unchanged when set). Follow-up implementation filed as loreweaver-d4r.3/.4/.5. Docs-only change; no code quality gates apply.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Revised ADR 0004: removed backward-compat/migration framing since Loreweaver has no released installations. The managed per-user model is now specified directly and supersedes ADR 0003 outright when implemented (no migration step). LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH is kept as a deliberate explicit-path feature, not a compat shim.
